name: Csákánydoroszló (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csákánydoroszló (a blue shield with a white lion and a castle, with yellow and blue mantling) above the name CSÁKÁNYDOROSZLÓ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
